newsitem.title: FRANCE: Equitable kicks in 1.45 bln Ffr to Axa 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Equitable kicks in 1.45 bln Ffr to Axa 96 profit.

text.p: French insurer Axa said on Wednesday that its U.S. unit Equitable will contribute 1.45 billion francs to its 1996 profits.
The figure is down from Equitable's contribution of 1.55 billion francs the previous year.
"It is a stable contribution which does not herald any change in the forecasts of analysts for the 1996 result of Axa," a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said that stock market analysts had estimated Axa's net profit would be between 3.5 billion and 3.8 billion francs.
Equitable announced 1996 net profit of $99.1 million compared to $365.4 million in 1995. Turnover was $8.31 billion, versus $7.28 billion.

A decision by the U.S. company to boost its reserves for the disability income business was aimed at wiping out future losses in the sector, which generated a net loss of $47.1 million last year, the spokeswoman added. wem/pnt
